press.comment: I like option 1 best, but it' not quite right yet, especially on the buttons it's too bright
press.reply: Option 1, the sun swells, stays, and is toned down: on the buttons the pressed face now lifts about 1.2 to 1.4 times the rest brightness instead of 1.5 to 1.7 (the glow at about half, the foot line softer, the face moving half-way to its pressed shade). In and out are still the same time (t50 120 ms, t90 200 ms). Options 2 and 3 follow the same lower level.
